onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: SpeakEase needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

shortcut.title: SpeakEase Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Dictate
transcribe.description: Hold or tap to talk; the text lands where your cursor is.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Stops the recording without pasting anything.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Dictate with AI
transcribe_with_post_process.description: AI rewrites what you said with the AI shortcut's prompt.

transcribe_translate.name: Translate
transcribe_translate.description: Pastes a translation, in the language set in AI & Translate.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

shortcutActivation.title: Shortcut Behavior
shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the transcribe shortcut starts and stops recording.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Hold to record or tap to toggle
descriptions.push_to_talk: Records while you hold the shortcut
descriptions.toggle: Tap the shortcut to start recording, tap again to stop

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside SpeakEase

picks.title: Suggested for {{language}}
picks.chooseLanguage: Choose a language to see which models suit it:

live.label: Live text
live.why: Words appear while you are still speaking

light.label: Lightest
light.why: Small download, runs on any Mac

picks.shortOnly: Tiny, but only for sentences under ~25 seconds

sound.title: Sound

channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

sound.previewTheme: Play the start and stop sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start SpeakEase when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the SpeakEase icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English inside the model
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.
translateToEnglish.aiTranslates: Off while AI translates on the Speak page; the two would translate twice.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A–Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified or Traditional characters. Other languages are left unchanged.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Apple Intelligence runs on this Mac: free, and nothing you say leaves it. Other services need an API key and charge per request.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: The prompt the AI shortcut uses. The translate shortcut uses the language chosen above.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.
prompts.groupDescription: The prompt the AI shortcut uses. Edit it or add your own; they all appear under AI cleanup too.

main.title: Main shortcut
main.groupDescription: The same choices as the AI chips on the Speak page.

enhance.title: AI cleanup
enhance.description: How AI tidies everything you dictate with the main shortcut.

language.title: Translate into
language.description: The language the translate shortcut uses, and the main shortcut while it translates.

translate.label: Translate every dictation into {{language}}
translate.description: The main shortcut pastes the translation instead of what you said.

history.title: History
history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.copyError: Failed to copy transcription to clipboard.
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.
history.stats: {{entries}} dictations · {{words}} words · about {{minutes}} min of typing saved

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of SpeakEase

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview Onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions, models, or completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Use AI
postProcessingToggle.description: Clean up and translate what you say with AI. Off: you get exactly what you said, and the AI shortcuts stop working.

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard Diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach SpeakEase. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching SpeakEase normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show What's New
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after SpeakEase updates

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where SpeakEase stores its data

sourceCode.description: SpeakEase is built on Handy, the open-source app by CJ Pais (MIT)

supportDevelopment.description: Support the Handy project SpeakEase is built on

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: SpeakEase's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

credits.title: Built on Handy
credits.description: SpeakEase is built on Handy by CJ Pais (MIT licence) and runs speech models through ggml.

theme.description: Choose whether SpeakEase follows your system theme or stays light or dark

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes

quickStart.title: Start talking
quickStart.subtitle: Hold a shortcut, speak, let go: the text lands where your cursor is.

rows.transcribe_with_post_process: Dictate, then let AI tidy it

vietnameseModels.cohere: Most accurate for Vietnamese, fast, 14 languages.

vietnameseModels.funasr: Balanced speed and accuracy, lighter than Cohere.
vietnameseModels.moonshine_vi: Tiny (86 MB), Vietnamese only; fails on clips over 25 seconds.
vietnameseModels.whisper_turbo: Multilingual Whisper, steady, slower than the ones above.
vietnameseModels.nemotron: Fastest, shows text while you speak, but makes more mistakes.

language.title: Listen for
language.viHint: More accurate when you only speak Vietnamese
language.autoTriesBoth: Tries Vietnamese and English, remembers what you speak

ai.title: AI cleanup
ai.disabledHint: AI is switched off, so nothing is cleaned up or translated. You get exactly what you said.

files.linkPlaceholder: Or paste a link: YouTube, or a link to an .mp3 / .mp4 file
files.turnOnAi: Turn on AI to rewrite and translate

errors.busy: Another file is being processed. Wait for it or cancel it, then try again.
errors.unsupported: This format can't be read yet. Use MP3, M4A, MP4, MOV, WAV, FLAC or OGG.
errors.no_speech: No speech was heard in the file.
errors.bad_link: That isn't a valid link. Paste one starting with https://.
errors.download_failed: Couldn't download from this link. Check your connection or the link and try again.
errors.needs_yt_dlp: This link is a web page. Install yt-dlp (brew install yt-dlp) to get the sound from YouTube and other video sites.
errors.no_model: No speech model yet. Download one in Recognition.
errors.ai_off: AI is off. Turn it on in AI & Translate to rewrite and translate.
errors.ai_failed: The AI didn't answer. Check AI & Translate and try again.
errors.other: Something went wrong with the file. Try again.

files.keptOriginal: {{kept}} of {{total}} parts kept their original words
